Hybrid:
example (ℓ : ℕ) (w : List Bool) (i : Fin ℓ) :
    TCSlib.Cryptography.padFin ℓ w i = w.getD i false := by
  rfl
Handler:
example (n : ℕ) (z ω s : List Bool) (i : Fin 2) (x L : List Bool) :
    TCSlib.Cryptography.Games.InteractiveHandler.input n z ω s i x L =
      Turing.pairEncode (Turing.pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Turing.pairEncode z ω))
        (Turing.pairEncode s (Turing.pairEncode (Turing.pairEncode (List.replicate i true) x) L)) := by
  rfl
Games:
example (S : TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability.FixedLengthPKScheme) (n : ℕ) :
    S.inLens n 0 = S.ctLen.eval n := by
  rfl
Owned:
example (S : TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability.FixedLengthPKScheme) (cap : Complexity.PolyExpr)
    (ist : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability.AdaptiveCPA.acHandler S cap ist).perCall = .const 1 := by
  rfl
